items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Like I said, Don Byas was his idol and I think, head Don heard enough of him, Don would've said the same thing about him.

ctx.x: Was that evident to you then? Or is that evident to you now?

It was evident to me because they were both fantastic musicians. They were both great players. Wardell, I believe later, worked with Basie if I'm not mistaken. Lucky played with some other bands. I think Lucky had a problem. He had two sons and he had something unfortunate happen in his family life that made it necessary for him to raise both the sons and work at the same time. It became very difficult to do. I think it caused a lot of problems with him, not only financially, but also otherwise. He wound up in…
heard enough of him, Don would've said the same thing about him. He would've had to.
